# Support for AGYOS

## Getting Help

- **Documentation**: Visit [https://agyos.pages.dev](https://agyos.pages.dev) for comprehensive architecture guides and API references.
- **Discussions**: Start a thread on [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/krishujeniya/AGYOS/discussions).
- **Issues**: If you discover a confirmed bug or have a feature proposal, use the [Issue Templates](https://github.com/krishujeniya/AGYOS/issues/new/choose).
- **Security**: Report potential vulnerabilities privately following [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
